TopicProgress.title: TopicProgress
TopicProgress.description: Tracks a CSIR NET Life Sciences aspirant's study status and bookmark flag for a specific syllabus topic.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this progress record.

unitNumber.description: CSIR NET Life Sciences syllabus unit number (1 to 13).

status.description: Current mastery status for the topic.

bookmarked.description: Whether the topic is bookmarked for quick revision.

updatedAt.description: Server-generated last update timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PersonalNote.title: PersonalNote
PersonalNote.description: User-authored personal study note, mnemonic, formula sheet, or PYQ trap note linked to a CSIR NET unit/topic.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this personal note.

unitNumber.description: CSIR NET Life Sciences syllabus unit number (1 to 13).

topicId.description: Optional syllabus topic ID linked to this note.

topicTitle.description: Optional syllabus topic title linked to this note.

title.description: Short descriptive title of the personal study note.

content.description: Body text of the personal revision note or mnemonic.

tag.description: Category tag for organizing revision notes.

updatedAt.description: Server-generated last update timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/topicProgress/{topicId}.description: Per-user study mastery status and bookmark flags keyed by topicId.

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Per-user personal study notes, mnemonics, and PYQ pointers.
